full_judgment:
2. Appellants who are pre-emptors filed Miscellaneous Case No.115 of 1973 in the 1st court of Subordinate Judge, Dhaka on 10 September 1973 under section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act. Appellants are co-sharers by inheritance and respondent Nos. 1-7 are the strangers and respondent No.14 is the transferor. In the sale deed the land was shown as 1.14 acre and the consideration money was stated to be Tk. 7,000/-. It was stated in the application for pre-emption that since the transferor had right, title and interest only in 54½ acre of lands the appellants' prayer for pre-emption was in respect of only this quantity of land and not the entire land shown as sold under the deed and that the pre-emptee-respondents be allowed to withdraw Tk. 3084.93 out of total deposited amount. 

 7. In the circumstances Mr. Golam Rabbani, however, tried to convince us that in view of the deposit of entire consideration money stated in the sale deed it cannot be said to be a case of partial pre-emption though the appellants prayed for the pre-emption of only. 54½ acres of land instead of 1.14 acres of land sold under the kabala. When the prayer in the application for pre-emption is for a part only of the entire land sold under the kabala the Court is not required to make the deduction that prayer must be read in respect of the whole when the entire consideration money stated in the kabala had been deposited by the appellants. Neither can the Court be expected to enter into the investigation regarding the title of respondent No.14 in the entire land covered by the kabala. 

 For the reasons stated above, the appeal is dismissed without any order as to costs.
